responses: To reset your password, click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and enter your registered email address. We'll send you a secure password reset link.
If your account is locked due to multiple failed attempts, please wait 15 minutes or click 'Reset Password'. You can also reach our support team for an immediate manual unlock.
For Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) issues, please check your authenticator app or SMS inbox. If you still don't receive the code, try our backup recovery codes or contact Support.

responses: To create a new account, click the 'Sign Up' or 'Register' button on the top right corner of our homepage and fill in your details.
You can update your personal information, email, or password anytime by navigating to 'Account Settings' -> 'Profile'.
If you wish to deactivate or permanently delete your account, visit 'Account Settings' -> 'Security & Privacy' -> 'Delete Account'. Note that this action is irreversible.

responses: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Net Banking.
All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption and comply with PCI-DSS standards for maximum security.

If your payment was declined, please verify your card details, billing address, or contact your issuing bank. Any deducted funds for failed transactions are automatically reversed within 3-5 business days.
Invoices and billing receipts can be downloaded directly from your 'Billing History' tab in Account Settings.

responses: We offer a 30-day hassle-free money-back guarantee. You can request a refund directly from your 'Order History' page by selecting 'Request Refund'.
Once approved, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days and credited back to your original payment method.
To check the status of your refund, visit 'Orders' -> 'Refund Status'. You will also receive email updates as your refund progresses.
If your refund hasn't arrived after 7 business days from approval, please contact your bank or reach our support team with your transaction reference number.

In accordance with GDPR and CCPA, you have the right to request a complete copy of your stored data or request permanent deletion at privacy@example.com.
